description: This file defines a Java interface, 'DeleteFeatureLiveCommand', which extends multiple interfaces related to live commands and feature modification within the Eclipse Ditto project. It serves as an entry point for creating commands and accessors for deleting features in a live environment.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommand
classes.description: A Java interface representing a live command for deleting a feature, providing access to command creation, special accessors, and feature identification.

methods.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommand
methods.description: Constructor for the DeleteFeatureLiveCommand interface; in Java, this defines the interface itself rather than a method.
